The hypothesis claimed a single algebraic manipulation: substituting Λₙ = 2·n·h and A = ½ + h into the exponent –2·A + Λₙ and simplifying to –1 + 2·h·(n–1). The identity checks ran that exact substitution and simplification, and the symbolic evaluation returned “consistent” — the left- and right-hand sides match exactly for all h and n.
